newsitem.title: GERMANY: Krupp sees no merger, but non-steel JVs.
newsitem.headline: Krupp sees no merger, but non-steel JVs.

text.p: Germany's Krupp group said on Monday that its decision to drop a hostile takeover bid for Thyssen AG did not herald a friendly merger, but there was scope for joint ventures outside the steel production area.
"This does not mean that there will be a merger between the two groups," a spokesman for Fried. Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp said.
The two companies had just issued a joint statement saying that talks on forming a joint steel venture were going well and cooperation could be possible in other business areas.
But the spokesman cautioned that the broader cooperation signalled in the joint statement did not mean that the hostile bid would be turned into a friendly one.
Krupp last week offered 435 marks a share to take over Thyssen, a 25 percent premium to the market at the time.
Krupp said in the joint statement it would not in future relaunch its bid.
